gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.kort.1: To the stage of the Bubble Bowl
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.nu.10: Tonight there is a party in the Bubble Bowl, the big stadium in the north. Squidmika has to perform and has no band... Climb onto the stage and grab the drum!
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.nu.10_: Hit the drum when the bubbles pop on the beat. Missing a few doesn't matter: the town sings along anyway.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.nu.7: Back to The Krusty Nibble: Mr. Krabguh is calling everybody together. Something terrible happened to the safe in his office.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.nu.8: Plankmika has the secret recipe! Sneak into The Grease Bucket (the big bucket across the street from The Krusty Nibble), to the lab at the back. Stay out of sight of the cameras and don't step through the lasers.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.nu.8_b: You have the recipe! Sneak back outside without Karen noticing.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.nu.9: Bring the secret recipe back to Mr. Krabguh in The Krusty Nibble.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.nu.kla: The secret recipe is back and Squidmika is a star! Mr. Krabguh will have big news soon...
